approaches.title: Track nesting depth and filter outer parentheses
approaches.summary: Scan parentheses while maintaining nesting depth, keeping each character only when it is inside a primitive component rather than its outermost pair. The revisions express this same strategy with different iterator formulations.

revisions.shortChangeSummary: Tracks depth using a parity-named counter and filters characters based on whether they remain inside the current primitive pair.
Makes the depth updates explicit for opening and closing parentheses, with the same filtering strategy.
Uses `scan` to carry depth through the iterator, then filters out characters marked as outermost.
